purpose: Teach: 吸収/原料/発掘/天候/未知/絶滅/換算/沿岸

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、栄養の、本気で、絶対、吸収、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on nutrition absorption was genuinely impressive. I was really struck by how seriously you engaged with it.
lines.style: Warm, steady approval. Leans forward slightly. Genuine appreciation in the voice—not flattery. Clear enunciation on key words like 'nutrition' and 'absorption.' Measured pace that gives weight to the compliment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。化学工場の、本気で、絶対、原料、絶対、調達、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I put real effort into researching the supply chain for raw materials in chemical manufacturing. I'm grateful you noticed the depth of the work.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness, almost humble. Slight breath before speaking. Steady eye contact in the voice. Not rushing—letting each phrase settle. Genuine gratitude, not performative.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 考古学の、本気で、絶対、発掘、絶対、現場、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your archaeology paper—the excavation site analysis—was genuinely thoughtful. That kind of fieldwork research doesn't go unnoticed.
lines.style: Reflective, appreciative tone. Slight pause before naming the topic, as if picturing it. Warm but observant. The voice of someone who reads carefully and remembers what stands out.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。気候変動による、本気で、絶対、天候、絶対、不順、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I focused on how climate change affects weather patterns at archaeological sites. It was a challenging but meaningful research project. Thank you for recognizing the rigor.
lines.style: Clear, direct delivery. Modest but not self-effacing. Speaks with quiet confidence about the work's depth. Steady pacing. Gratitude feels earned and genuine, not reflexive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 深海の、本気で、絶対、未知、絶対、生物、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And that deep-sea biodiversity paper—the one on unknown species—was remarkable. You brought real focus to such complex material.
lines.style: Engaged, animated compared to earlier lines. Slight brightness in the voice. Specific recall of the topic. Speaks with the satisfaction of someone who encountered genuinely good work. Maintains warmth throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。希少種の、本気で、絶対、絶滅、絶対、危機、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I researched extinction risk in rare marine species. It demanded deep investigation into ecological systems. I appreciate you taking the time to really see that work.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the voice without arrogance. Slow, careful delivery—he's being precise about what the research entailed. Gratitude feels sincere because it acknowledges her actual attention.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 通貨の、本気で、絶対、換算、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your currency conversion analysis was methodical and clear. The way you structured that economic argument was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Steady approval with gentle emphasis on the method. Appreciative but not overstating. Pause before 'currency conversion' as if recalling specifics. Voice suggests she's naming something she actually remembers and valued.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。離島の、本気で、絶対、沿岸、絶対、生態、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I examined the coastal ecosystem dynamics of isolated island communities. The research required careful investigation of interconnected systems. Thank you for seeing how thorough it was.
lines.style: Final line carries quiet completion—he's summarized his work with genuine pride and gratitude. Warm but measured. Not rushed. The voice of someone who has been truly heard and appreciated.
